semantic_fragments.content: Conditions of acceptability: 1) 201.11.7 Biocompatibility of ME EQUIPMENT and ME is not evaluated in this report. 2) 201.17 Electromagnetic compatibility of ME EQUIPMENT and ME SYSTEMS is not evaluated in this report. 3) 201.102 CLINICAL ACCURACY VALIDATION is not evaluated in this report. 4) 202 Electromagnetic disturbances - Requirements and tests is not evaluated in this report. 5) 206 Usability is not evaluated in this report.

The tests results presented in this report relate only to the object tested. This report shall not be reproduced except in full without the written approval of the testing laboratory. List of test equipment must be kept on file and available for review. This Test Report Form is intended for the investigation of clinical thermometers for body temperature measurement in accordance with EN ISO 80601-2-56:2017/A1:2020/ISO 80601-2-56:2017+A1:2018. It can only be used together with IEC 60601-1:2005. Additional test data and/or information provided in the attachments to this report. Throughout this report a comma/point is used as the decimal separator.

General disclaimer: The test results presented in this report relate only to the object tested. Without permission of the Report department this test report is not permitted to be duplicated in extracts.
Copy of marking plate: The artwork below may be only a draft. The use of certification marks on a product must be authorized by the respective NCBs that own these marks.

The RISKS of changing environmental conditions for the CLINICAL THERMOMETER are considered in RISK MANAGEMENT PROCESS. Guidance regarding the RESIDUAL RISKS is provided in the instruction for use (Refer to Operation Guide).

At least one of the following functions is identified as ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE in RISK MANAGEMENT FILE: accuracy of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER; generation of a TECHNICAL ALARM CONDITION; not providing an OUTPUT TEMPERATURE.

The packaging of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER and PROBE is marked with: a) MEASURING SITE and REFERENCE BODY SITE (N/A); b) mode of operation of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER; c) appropriate symbol from ISO 15223-1:2016 used for sterile packaging (Table 201.D.2.101, symbols 3-8); d) Symbol 5.1.4 of ISO 15233-1:2016 used for CLINICAL THERMOMETER or PROBE with expiration date (Table 201.D.2.101, symbol 2); e) special storage and/or handling instructions. For a specific MODEL OR TYPE REFERENCE, the indication of single use shall be consistent (No single use).

Instructions for use shall contain: a) a summary of the USE SPECIFICATION as determined for IEC 62366-1:2015; b) MEASURING SITE and REFERENCE BODY of CLINICAL THERMOMETER specified (See chapter 'Intended use' of user manual); c) recommended minimum measuring time and minimum time between measurements for each intended MEASURING SITE; d) RATED OUTPUT RANGE for each intended REFERENCE BODY SITE (See chapter 'Safety Precaution' of user manual); e) the LABORATORY ACCURACY in the RATED OUTPUT RANGE (See chapter 'Product performance' of user manual); f) for CLINICAL THERMOMETERS for use with PROBE COVER: instruction how to apply PROBE COVER and information about behaviour when used without PROBE COVER (No PROBE COVER used); g) mode of operation (DIRECT MODE or ADJUSTED MODE) (See chapter 'Product specifications' of user manual); h) instructions for selection and replacement of INTERNAL ELECTRICAL POWER SOURCES (See chapter 'Setup and operating procedures' in user manual).
Instructions provided on nature of maintenance and/or calibration needed to ensure proper function and its frequency. Result: P
Information about disposal of the clinical thermometer and its components. See chapter 'Maintenance' in user manual. Result: P

If the CLINICAL THERMOMETER and/or its components are intended for single use only, information on characteristics and technical factors that could pose a RISK is provided in instructions for use. Result: N/A
Confirm that the MANUFACTURER has evaluated the effects of multiple PROCESS cycles and the effectiveness of those cycles as part of the 100-cycle cleaning/disinfection compliance verification.

If the INTENDED USE of a CLINICAL THERMOMETER, PROBE, its parts or ACCESSORIES includes treatment of children or treatment of pregnant or nursing women, a specific justification for the use of phthalates shall be included in the RISK MANAGEMENT FILE. The instructions for use shall contain information on RESIDUAL RISKS for these PATIENT groups and, if applicable, on appropriate precautionary measures.

If the CLINICAL THERMOMETER cannot indicate a temperature within the LABORATORY ACCURACY, it either provides a TECHNICAL ALARM CONDITION or it does not provide an OUTPUT TEMPERATURE. Minimum RATED OUTPUT RANGE of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER is from 34°C to 42°C. Actual rated output range: 32.0°C to 42.9°C.

CLINICAL THERMOMETERS intended for home healthcare use require the display of OUTPUT TEMPERATURE of at least 4mm or the value is optically magnified to this height. This is indicated in USABILITY ENGINEERING PROCESS. Actual display height: 10mm.

Laboratory performance is assessed in DIRECT MODE or in TEST MODE under the same conditions. Alternatively correction method is used to derive unadjusted temperatures from OUTPUT TEMPERATURE in accordance with the ACCOMPANYING DOCUMENT. Tested in test mode.

CLINICAL ACCURACY VALIDATION: ADJUSTED MODE CLINICAL THERMOMETER are VALIDATED for CLINICAL ACCURACY in each ADJUSTED MODE in accordance with ISO 14155-1:2003 and ISO 14155-2:2003. The results of CLINICAL ACCURACY VALIDATION is disclosed in the ACCOMPANYING DOCUMENT. Requirements cover: human subject population (febrile subjects 30-50%, minimum 105 total, minimum 35 per age group, minimum 15 in A1 or A2); age groups A1 (0-3 months), A2 (3-12 months), B (>1 and <5 years), C (>5 years); Clinical Bias (∆cb); Limits of Agreement (LA); Clinical Repeatability (σr). All marked N/E in this report.
Electromagnetic compatibility (clause 201.17, IEC 60601-1:2005 Clause 17) is not evaluated in this report. ME SYSTEMS (clause 201.16) is not applicable as the device is not an ME system.

The CLINICAL THERMOMETER may exhibit temporary degradation of performance (e.g. deviation from the performance indicated in the instructions for use during IMMUNITY testing), which does not require OPERATOR intervention and that does not affect BASIC SAFETY or ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE. In the event of disruption during IMMUNITY tests, the CLINICAL THERMOMETER shall recover from any disruption within 30 s.

The following degradations, if associated with BASIC SAFETY or ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE, shall not be allowed: component failures; changes in programmable parameters or settings; reset to default settings; change of operating mode; change in LABORATORY ACCURACY at any point in the RATED OUTPUT RANGE and in the RATED EXTENDED OUTPUT RANGE greater than permitted in 201.101.2 without the generation of either a TECHNICAL ALARM CONDITION or an indication of abnormal operation.

For a CLINICAL THERMOMETER, the following shall be considered PRIMARY OPERATING FUNCTIONS: a) observing the OUTPUT TEMPERATURE; b) properly positioning CLINICAL THERMOMETER or PROBE at the MEASURING SITE; c) starting the CLINICAL THERMOMETER from power off; d) turning off the CLINICAL THERMOMETER; e) performing a basic pre-use functional check of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER. The following functions, if available, also shall be considered PRIMARY OPERATING FUNCTIONS: f) performing a basic pre-use functional check of the ALARM SIGNALS; g) configuring the ACCESSORIES including connection of the detachable parts to the CLINICAL THERMOMETER; h) REPROCESSING the ACCESSORIES; i) setting the OPERATOR-adjustable controls: switching between MEASURING SITES; setting CLINICAL THERMOMETER control parameters; setting ALARM LIMITS; inactivating ALARM SIGNALS.

Amendment to IEC 60601-1-2:2014 clause 4.3.1: if applicable, attachment of ACCESSORIES as necessary to achieve the BASIC SAFETY and ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER shall be included in configurations for electromagnetic disturbance testing.

Clause 212.10.1.1 Amendment: The tests of IEC 60601-1-12:2014, Clause 10 and IEC 60601-1:2005+A1:2012, 15.3 shall be performed on the same sample of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER after the cleaning and disinfection PROCEDURES of 201.11.6.6 of this document have been performed unless there are no cleaning and disinfection PROCEDURES specified in the instructions for use. If more than one PROCEDURE is specified in the instructions for use, each PROCEDURE shall be so tested.

Clause 211.10.1.1: The tests of IEC 60601-1-11:2015, Clause 10 and IEC 60601-1:2005+A1:2012, 15.3 shall be performed on the same sample of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER after the cleaning and disinfection PROCEDURES. See Appended Table 211.10.1.1.

Laboratory accuracy test (201.101.2): The clinical thermometer was tested at three measurement points (midpoint, upper limit, lower limit of rated output range 32.0°C to 42.9°C) under five ambient condition combinations ranging from 10.5°C to 39.5°C and 20% to 90%RH. All measured equation values were within ±0.2°C. The rated extended output range is N/A. Overall result: Pass (P).

Combination of upper and lower limits of environmental temperature and humidity ranges: 1. Midpoint of humidity and ambient temperature; 2. Upper limit of humidity + upper limit of ambient temperature; 3. Upper limit of humidity + lower limit of ambient temperature; 4. Lower limit of humidity + upper limit of ambient temperature; 5. Lower limit of humidity + lower limit of ambient temperature.

TRTS – Measured temperature of REFERENCE TEMPERATURE SOURCE; TTUT – Measured temperature of CLINICAL THERMOMETER under test; TRCT – Measured temperature of REFERENCE CLINICAL THERMOMETER. Note: reference temperature source and reference clinical thermometer are same one thermometer.

Clause 201.12.1.101 requirement: When the CLINICAL THERMOMETER is not capable of indicating a temperature within the LABORATORY ACCURACY, it shall provide a TECHNICAL ALARM CONDITION or it shall not provide an OUTPUT TEMPERATURE. Observed behavior: The CLINICAL THERMOMETER shows 'LOW POWER REMINDER' symbol when low voltage of the internal electrical power source. The CLINICAL THERMOMETER shows '- - -°F' or '- - -℃' when output temperature is outside the rated extended output range. This requirement appears under both clause 201.11.6.6 (Cleaning and disinfection) and clause 211.10.1.1 (General requirements for mechanical strength) test tables.

requirements.description: Cleaning and disinfection of ME EQUIPMENT and ME SYSTEM

sub_requirements.description: The surfaces of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER, PROBE and ACCESSORIES that can become contaminated with body fluids during NORMAL CONDITION or SINGLE FAULT CONDITION shall be designed to allow for cleaning and disinfection or cleaning and sterilization
The CLINICAL THERMOMETER may be dismantled during the decontamination PROCESS
ACCESSORIES not intended for re-use are exempt from this requirement

CLINICAL THERMOMETER and PROBE ENCLOSURES shall be designed to allow for surface cleaning and disinfection to reduce to acceptable levels the RISK of infection of OPERATORS, bystanders, or the PATIENT
Instructions for processing and REPROCESSING the CLINICAL THERMOMETER, PROBE and ACCESSORIES shall comply with ISO 17664:2004 and ISO 14937:2009 and shall be disclosed in the instructions for use

Check compliance by inspection of the RISK MANAGEMENT FILE. Clean and disinfect 100 times in accordance with the methods indicated in the instruction for use, including any cooling or drying period. After these PROCEDURES, confirm that BASIC SAFETY and ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE are maintained.

MANUFACTURERS of PROBES, PROBE CABLE EXTENDERS and PROBE COVERS conduct tests to ensure that all CLINICAL THERMOMETER specifications are met with each MODEL OR TYPE REFERENCE of CLINICAL THERMOMETER with which they are intended to be used
All CLINICAL THERMOMETERS with which compatibility to the PROBES, PROBE CABLE EXTENDERS and PROBE COVERS is claimed are listed in the ACCOMPANYING DOCUMENT

It is the responsibility of the MANUFACTURER of a PROBE, PROBE CABLE EXTENDER and PROBE COVER, including a REPROCESSED PROBE, PROBE CABLE EXTENDER and PROBE COVER, to have their PROCESSES VALIDATED to ensure that any new or REPROCESSED product complies with the requirements of this particular standard
